verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a block-based editor: blocks can be linked and embedded across objects, templates prefill blocks, and images become reusable image objects. A community user also describes the media handling and Notion-like feel. Nothing in the pack documents headings, callouts, tables, code blocks or keyboard-driven editing; the only keyboard shortcut mentioned is for starting AI chats. Missing for 10: documented headings, callouts, tables and code blocks; keyboard-first editing and shortcuts; evidence of editor speed; broader embedded-media support beyond images; independent hands-on corroboration of editing quality.
